answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 25928 Country: India Title: I WILL MARRIED LAST 5 YEARS, BUT I HAVE NO KIDS. SO PLEASE GIVE ME SOME ADVICE & SEND ME SOME DUAS FOR IT. I BELIEVE ONLY IN ALLAH. Question: SALLAM.W I WILL MARRIED LAST 5 YEARS, BUT I HAVE NO KIDS. SO PLEASE GIVE ME SOME ADVICE & SEND ME SOME DUAS FOR IT. I BELIEVE ONLY IN ALLAH. KHUDA HAFIZ Answer ID: 25928 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2142/H=740/th=1431) Both of you (husband and wife) should recite the following verse after each salah and before going to bed 11 times with durood 11-11 times before and after in the state of wudhu: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَاماً [الفرقان : 74] Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
